experiment: E08 A/B: stability and synthetic mechanisms

A1.environment_scope: Synthetic finite MDP only: E=4 actions, H=4 rounds, 6 nodes, budget 0.05, per-action costs in {0, 0.02, 0.05}, 20 seeded random sparse transition tables, float64 CPU, exhaustive enumeration. Verifies Markov-sufficiency of the declared state; says nothing about natural-language MoE hidden states.

A2.environment_scope: Synthetic C1 counterexample only: binary X, erased hidden state + 32-dim irrelevant Gaussian noise, label noise zeta in (0.0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5). Hidden state is deliberately insufficient; a positive history gain here is NOT evidence that real MoE needs memory. Train/test sizes 100000/20000, linear probes, CPU.

scaled_control_small_mlp_trained_on_all_.note: same h-only MLP catches up with full data -> function-class/readability explanation

A3.environment_scope: Synthetic parity only: 8-bit exhaustive (256 inputs, 128/128 random split) and 12-bit (4096 inputs, 2048/2048 random split). History features are cumulative input parities (input-derived, never read labels). Results do not imply natural-language generalization.

B1.environment_scope: Synthetic delayed-reward envs only: exact C5 (2 tokens, budget 2, chains A=(0.1,9.9), B=(6,0)) and 30 seeded random 8-token/4-step envs with 1-2 planted low-then-high chains; costs uniform {1} and non-uniform {1,2,4} evaluated separately. Supervised Q controller is trained and evaluated on uniform-cost envs only. Recovered two-step gains here do not imply the same structure exists in natural language.

B2.environment_scope: Synthetic C2 only: X = 1 bit + 7 noise dims, Y = X with probability 0.5+0.5*signal, signal sweep (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0). Guards against claiming a value model learned Q* from label-visible cherry-picking; conclusions are limited to this action set {0.99, 0.01, 0.5}.

extrapolation_length_5_6_exact_experts.label: EXTRAPOLATION - not comparable to H<=4 budget table

B3.environment_scope: Synthetic ordered composition only: 4 affine experts mod 97, train lengths 1-4 with held-out complete paths (all single ops and adjacent pairs still covered in training). Phase-1 router supervision reads the operation description; phase-2 MLP experts are trained on 60/97 inputs each. Concludes only that the control mechanism can learn ordered composition; does not claim real experts have prescribed semantics.
